name: Archie daily factory report and stop-the-line beat (yesterday's report once a day after archie.report.send_hour_utc; ONE immediate Telegram beat per stop-the-line incident)

knobs.note: BH-4588: 0 stops the tick before any read: no report and no stop-the-line beat. Read by bin/archie-fm-report.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMR_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-fm-report.log and the default. The send hour, the stop-the-line ages and the beat cap are the archie.report.* and archie.stl.* settings rows; the mode is archie.manage.hub > archie.manage.
BH-4588: open alerts bin/lib/archie-fm-report/stl.sh reads per state (new, triaged, parked) on each tick; a full page is one log line and only what was read is checked.

BH-4588: seconds of the outer backstop timeout on one tick. Read by bin/archie-fm-report.sh through lane_knob before it re-execs itself; 600 is the code fallback when the lane-gate lib is missing or the value is not a positive number.
BH-4588: seconds between the backstop's TERM and its KILL (timeout -k). Read by bin/archie-fm-report.sh through lane_knob before it re-execs; 30 is the code fallback.

Not a knob: bin/archie-fm-report.sh sets it to 1 when it re-execs itself under its backstop timeout (ARCHIE_FMR_TICK_CEILING_S), so the child does not wrap itself again. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-fm-report.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-fm-report.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.

Test seam gate: bin/archie-fm-report.sh honours ARCHIE_FMR_NOW and sources ARCHIE_FMR_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
